info.title: Project and Resource Management
info.description: Project and Resource Management enables services companies to automate many of the functions of financial project management.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Projects
tags.description:
Use projects in Sage Intacct to plan, manage, track, and report on work across your organization. Projects provide visibility into activities, costs, and outcomes, helping to ensure accountability and measure performance effectively. The project management capabilities in Sage Intacct enable organizations to streamline their project workflows, improve collaboration, and gain insights into project performance.

For more information, read [about projects](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Projects_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

For [Construction projects](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Construction_projects), Sage Intacct offers specialized features to manage the unique aspects of construction projects, including job costing, change order management, and compliance tracking. You must have a Construction subscription to access these features.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Project resources
tags.description:
Project resources represent people or employees assigned to a project. You can assign a resource, typically an employee, to a project, including details such as billing rates, roles and assignment dates.

For more information, read about [assigning project resources](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_project_resources) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Project statuses
tags.description:
Project statuses let you track the progress of projects through different states, used to categorize and report on projects. You can also disable (prevent) certain types of transactions from occurring in specific states, such as not allowing timesheet entries when a project is in a "Not Started" state.

For more information, read about [project statuses](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_project_statuses) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Project types
tags.description:
Project types let you group projects into categories for reporting. After defining project types, you can set each project to one of the types and then group and query based on the type.

For more information, read [about projects](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Projects_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Project groups
tags.description:
A project group is a specified set of projects, or a set of projects that meet certain criteria. You can use groups to filter or display information in multiple ways, for instance by showing data from only certain projects.

For more information, read [about projects](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Projects_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Project group members
tags.description:
Project group members are used to define the projects that belong to a project group. A project group can include all projects that meet certain criteria, or specific projects selected by the user.

For more information, read [about projects](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Projects_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Project observed percent completed
tags.description:
Project observed percent completed objects record dated progress updates for a project. Use these entries to track incremental progress over time based on observed completion values.

For more information, read about [observed percent complete based recognition](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Project_revenue_recognition) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Standard tasks
tags.description: Use standard tasks to create a catalog (library) of definitions that can be used to populate new project tasks with specific values, improving consistency across an organization.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Tasks
tags.description:
Tasks simplify the process of capturing task data for projects as you enter transactions. The uniqueness of a task is bound to a specific project, meaning you cannot select a task without first identifying the project. Projects and tasks are available with the Construction subscription.

Use tasks (a unit of work to be performed for a project) to:

- Identify which tasks are billable to the customer.
- Enter estimated and planned hours, track percent completed as the task progresses, and create recurring schedules.
- Create task dependencies so one task doesn't start until another finishes.

For more information, read more about [task dimensions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Task_dimension_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Task groups
tags.description:
Task groups categorize task dimension records, mainly for the purpose of structuring financial reporting. A task group is a type of dimension. A task group simplifies the process of capturing task data for projects as you enter transactions. A task group is bound to a specific project in the same way a task is bound to a project. This means you must first identify a project to be able to create a task group.

For more information, read [about task groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Proj-about-task-group) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Task resources
tags.description:
Task resources represent employees assigned to project tasks. Use task resources to track staffing details and planned or actual work for a task.

For more information, read about [task resources](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_project_resources) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Task observed percent completed
tags.description:
Task observed percent completed objects capture dated progress updates for a task. Use these entries to track incremental progress over time based on observed completion values.

For more information, read about [observed percent complete based recognition](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Project_revenue_recognition) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Standard cost types
tags.description:
Define standard cost types to create a catalog of definitions that can be used to create new cost types pre-populated with specific values, such as for labor, materials, and subcontracts.

Note: Construction companies record expenses using the work breakdown structure (WBS). In the industry, the WBS is traditionally defined as job/cost code/category. Sage Intacct uses project/task/cost type to reflect this structure.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Cost types
tags.description:
A cost type is a standard dimension used to capture and categorize project cost details in construction projects.

Each project typically has different cost types related to labor, materials, rented equipment, and other operational costs. Standard cost types serve as templates for creating new cost types.

Each cost type is associated with a task, which is in turn associated with a project. A cost type record is uniquely identified by the standard cost type used to create it, as well as the specific project and task it applies to.

Note: In the construction industry, the cost type corresponds with the category in the work breakdown structure (WBS).

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Project invoice runs
tags.description: An invoice run record is created every time you generate an invoice for a project. The invoice run shows the status of offline requests before and during processing, and shows the results of both online and offline requests. The invoice run shows whether or not the requested invoice was created successfully. If there were errors during processing, the invoice run provides error details to help you identify and resolve the issues.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Project billing templates
tags.description:
A billing template defines the rules that you want to use for invoicing a line item on a sales order, including whether the line item should be billed only when it's completed or at specific percentages of completion.

For more information, read the [billing template overview](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Billing_template_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Project billing template milestones
tags.description:
A project billing template milestone represents a specific billable event or checkpoint within a project billing template used for milestone billing. Each milestone defines a percentage of project completion that triggers an invoice to be sent to the client.

For more information, read about [fixed fee projects with percent complete billings](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Fixed_fee_percent_completed_projects) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Position skills
tags.description: A position-skill object contains the name and description of a position and skill level that can be assigned to employees for project planning.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Employee out of office schedules
tags.description:
Employee out of office schedules Employee out of office records capture periods when project resources are unavailable for planned work. Use these schedules to plan project work and avoid scheduling conflicts. For example, if an employee is on vacation or attending a training session, you can create an employee out of office schedule to indicate that they are unavailable during that time period.

For more information, read about [employee out of office schedules](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Resource_Scheduling_OOO) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Project_and_Resource_Management_Employee out of office lines
tags.description:
Employee out of office lines represent individual date-range entries that record when a project resource is unavailable. These entries are used with the employee out of office header to support staffing and scheduling workflows.

For more information, read about [employee out of offices](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Resource_Scheduling_OOO) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

post.description:
Creates a new project task within a specified project. You may provide either a project task 'id' or a standard task `id`. If a standard task is used, `key` or `id` is optional - when provided, the task is created based on that standard task template. 

If document sequencing is not enabled, `id` is required. If it is enabled, the task `id` is optional unless you wish to override the system-generated `id`.

If a parent task is provided, it must already exist in the project and defines the task hierarchy. If no parent task is specified, the system automatically creates any missing parent tasks based on the standard task hierarchy.

Task fields inherit values from the standard task unless defined in the request. Associated cost types from the standard task are also created automatically.

For more information, read about [adding tasks](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_and_Viewing_a_Task) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

patch.description:
Updates an existing task by setting field values. Any fields not provided remain unchanged.

If the task does not already reference a standard task, you may assign one by by providing a standard task `id`. The standard task `id` must exactly match the project task `id`. Assigning a standard task does not update any other task fields. Once set, the standard task reference or it's hierarchy cannot be changed.

For more information, read about [defining standard tasks](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Standard_tasks) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

post.description:
Creates a new cost type. When you create a cost type, the following field values from the given standard cost type are used unless you override them:

* `accumulationType`
* `glAccount`
* `parent`
* `item`

Custom field values from the standard cost type can also be used by the cost type. For this to work, the standard cost type and the cost type must have same custom fields with the same IDs, types, and lengths. Custom fields of type Sequence are not copied.

Parent-child relationships defined by standard cost types are preserved when cost types are created.

objects.projects.project.description: Use projects in Sage Intacct to plan, manage, track, and report on work across your organization.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the project.

description.description: Provides a brief description for the project.

projectCurrency.description: Specifies the currency used for the project.

category.description: Specifies the project category, used mainly for reporting and filtering purposes. You can use project categories to group and categorize projects.

projectStatus.description: References the current project status, used to track the progress of projects through different states. You can also use the project status to restrict transactions in the project.

key.description: Unique key for the project status.

disableGenerateInvoice.description: Indicates whether to generate project invoices for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent invoice generation.

disablePurchasingAPEntry.description: Indicates whether to create Accounts Payable (AP) or Purchase Order (PO) entries for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent AP/PO entries.

disableExpenseEntry.description: Indicates whether to create expense entries for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent expense entries.

disableTimesheetEntry.description: Indicates whether to create timesheet entries for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent timesheet entries.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project status.

startDate.description: Specifies the scheduled start date for the project.

endDate.description: Specifies the scheduled end date for the project.

budget.description: Indicates the budget projections for the project.

billingAmount.description: Budgeted billing amount for the project.

budgetedDuration.description: Budgeted duration (in hours) for the project.

glBudget.description: References the General Ledger (GL) budget used by revenue recognition to calculate the projected cost amount for the project.

key.description: Unique key for the budget.

href.description: URL endpoint for the budget.

contractAmount.description: Specifies the contracted amount for the project for reporting purposes.

actualAmount.description: Specifies the actual amount for the project for reporting purposes.

progress.description: Indicates the calculated progress for the project.

estimatedDuration.description: Estimated duration for the project in hours.

actualDuration.description: Actual duration for the project in hours.

approvedDuration.description: Approved duration for the project in hours.

remainingDuration.description: Remaining duration for the project in hours, calculated as the difference between estimated and actual duration.

percentComplete.description: Calculated percentage of project completion, based on the ratio of actual duration to estimated duration for project tasks.

observedPercentComplete.description: Observed percentage of project completion, indicating how complete the project is as of a specific date.

billingType.description:
Specifies how the project will be invoiced:

- `timeAndMaterial` - Invoices the customer for any time entry, expense, or AP/PO purchase that's marked as billable and assigned to this project.
- `fixedFee` - Invoices the customer for fixed fees, based on line items in an Order Entry transaction definition.
- `fixedFeeAndExpenses` - Invoices the customer for fixed fees, based on line items in an Order Entry transaction definition, plus any billable expenses.

salesOrderNumber.description: Specifies the sales order number for the project.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: Indicates the purchase order number for the project.

purchaseOrderAmount.description: Specifies the project purchase order amount.

purchaseQuoteNumber.description: Indicates the project purchase quote number.

documentNumber.description: Specifies a document number that can be used for custom project reporting.

parent.description: References the immediate parent project in the project hierarchy when the current project is a child project.

key.description: Unique key for the parent project.

href.description: URL endpoint for the parent project.

wipScheduleProject.description:
References the project included in the work-in-progress (WIP) schedule. This project consolidates values from multiple projects into a single WIP reporting project.

For more information, read [include projects in work in progress (WIP) schedules](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=include_projects_in_wip) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

key.description: Unique key for the WIP reporting project.

id.description: Identifier for the WIP reporting project.

name.description: Name for the WIP reporting project.

href.description: URL endpoint for the WIP reporting project.

excludeFromWIPSchedule.description: Indicates whether to exclude the project from work in progress schedules.

customer.description: References the customer associated with the project.

key.description: Unique key for the customer.

href.description: URL endpoint for the customer.

salesContact.description: References the sales contact for the project.

key.description: Unique key for the sales contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the sales contact.

projectType.description: References the project type, used to categorize and report on projects. Project types let you group projects into categories for reporting.

key.description: Unique key for the project type.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project type.

manager.description: References the project manager for the project. Project managers usually approve timesheets and expense reports, they can also run and view project reports.

key.description: Unique key for the project manager.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project manager.

department.description: References the department associated with this project. The project department overrides any department associated with an employee on a timesheet. If a project department is not set, the employee department is used.

key.description: Unique key for the department.

href.description: URL endpoint for the department.

location.description:
References the location associated with this project. The project location overrides any location associated with an employee on a timesheet. If a project location is not set, the employee location is used.

If you subscribe to Construction and you use WIP management, changing a project's location can cause the project to be handled incorrectly in WIP schedules. After changing a project's location, [check WIP project settings to ensure that the project is handled correctly in WIP schedules](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=include_projects_in_wip).

key.description: Unique key for the project location.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project location.

cipAsset.description: References the asset in construction in progress (CIP) associated with the project.

key.description: Unique key for the CIP asset.

name.example: Course Delivery Laptop - CIP Capital Equipment

href.description: URL endpoint for the CIP asset.

paymentTerm.description: References the Accounts Receivable (AR) payment term for the project, included on the invoice header. If `paymentTerm` is not set, the customer's terms are used.

key.description: Unique key for the AR payment term.

id.description: Identifier for the AR payment term.

href.description: URL endpoint for the AR payment term.

customerUser.description: References the Sage Intacct user assigned as a customer representative with the ability to approve timesheets for the project.

key.description: Unique key for the customer user.

class.description: References the class associated with this project. A class adds a value to the dimension that you can use to tag transactions for reporting.

key.description: Unique key for the class.

href.description: URL endpoint for the class.

userRestrictions.description:
Indicates the user restrictions for entering project time and expenses, overriding default user restrictions for the Projects application:





  - `systemDefault` - Use the restrictions set for the Projects application.
  - `anyUser` - Allow any user to enter time and expenses for the project.
  - `projectUsers` - Allow only users assigned to the project to enter time and expenses.
  - `projectTaskUsers` - Allow only users assigned to the project and task to enter time and expenses.

isBillableEmployeeExpense.description: Indicates whether to bill employee expenses for the project.

isBillablePurchasingAPExpense.description: Indicates whether to bill Accounts Payable (AP) and Purchase Order (PO) expenses for the project. Set to `true` to bill AP/PO expenses.

ratesAndPricing.description: Specifies the methods used to determine project billing rates and pricing, either `laborPricing` or `expensePricing`.

laborPricing.description:
Specifies the method used to determine labor pricing:

- `billingRate` - Pricing is based on a predefined billing rate. 
- `costPlusFee` - Pricing is based on actual costs plus a markup percentage.

laborMarkup.description: Indicates the percentage to add to labor costs when `laborPricing` is set to `costPlusFee`.

expensePricing.description:
Specifies the method used to determine expense pricing.

- `billingRate` - Charges are based on the vendor's billing rate.
- `costPlusFee` - Charges are based on the vendor's standard rate plus a markup percentage, specified in `expenseMarkup`.

expenseMarkup.description: Indicates the percentage to add to expense costs when `expensePricing` is set to `costPlusFee`.

defaultRate.description: Indicates the default percentage used to calculate pricing for Accounts Payable (AP), and Purchase Order (PO) transactions when generating project invoices.

purchasingAPPricing.description: Specifies the pricing method to be used for Accounts Payable (AP), and Purchase Order (PO) transactions.

contacts.description: References contact information for the project.

site.description: References the site contact for the project, the person or organization responsible for the project.

key.description: Unique key for the site contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the site contact.

primary.description: References the primary contact for the project, the person or organization responsible for the project.

key.description: Unique key for the primary contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the primary contact.

billTo.description: References the bill-to contact associated with the project, the person or organization responsible for paying project invoices. If not set, the customer contact will be used.

key.description: Unique key for the bill-to contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the bill-to contact.

shipTo.description: References the ship-to contact for the project, the person or organization to whom project invoices are sent. If not set, the customer contact is used for shipping.

key.description: Unique key for the ship-to contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the ship-to contact.

invoiceMessage.description: Specifies a custom invoice message that appears on the invoice header when you generate invoices for the project.

invoiceCurrency.description: Specifies the currency to use when generating invoices for the project.

billingOverMax.description:
Indicates the billing control to prevent or warn of billings that exceed the budgeted billing amount:





  - `doNothing` - Take no action if billings exceed the projected billing amount.
  - `issueAWarningMessage` - Issue a warning message when billings exceed the budgeted billing amount, but allow the billing to proceed.
  - `preventBilling` - If the invoice amount exceeds your projected billing amount, you cannot generate an invoice.

excludeExpenses.description: Indicates whether to exclude employee, Accounts Payable (AP), and Purchase Order (PO) expenses from the over-budget calculation. Set to `true` to exclude these expenses.

contract.description: References the contract associated with the project.

key.description: Unique key for the contract.

href.description: URL endpoint for the contract.

attachment.description: References documents associated with the project, such as statements of work, specifications, or agreements.

key.description: Unique key for the attachment.

href.description: URL endpoint for the attachment.

grant.description: References grant funding information for the project.

aln.description: Specifies the ALN (Assistance Listing Number) found on the Federal award letter was formerly known as CFDA (Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance). The ALN tracks federal awards and cooperative agreements. Reporting and auditing use the ALN.

fundedProjectName.description: Name for the project receiving the grant funding.

agency.description: Agency responsible for the grant funding, for example, `World Bank`.

payer.description: Source of the grant funding (`federal` or `third party`).

otherId.description: Provides an additional identifier for the grant funding.

assistanceType.description: Indicates the type of grant funding (`cash` or `nonCash`).

revenueRestriction.description:
Indicates the type of restriction on the received grant funding:

  - `purpose` - Funds are restricted by purpose, for example, to be used for a specific program or project, for example on education initiatives.
  - `time` - Funds are restricted by time, for example, to be used in a specific time period, for example within the current fiscal year.
  - `NA` - There are no restrictions on the use of the funds, there are no purpose or time restrictions.
  - `null` - If 'null', revenue restriction is not specified.

restrictionExpirationDate.description: Date when first restriction expires on time-based restricted funding.

isTimeSatisfactionScheduled.description: Indicates whether the release of restriction has been scheduled for time-based restrictions. Set to `true` if scheduled.

scopeDetails.description:
References information about the scope and schedule for the project, including scope of work, inclusions, exclusions, and terms. (Construction subscription)

For more information, read [add the scope and schedule to a project](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Add_scope_and_schedule_to_project) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

scope.description: Scope of the project, for example, the expected scope of work or materials to be delivered. Use 4000 or fewer characters.
scope.example: Subcontractor agrees to provide labor and materials for utility trenching for Five Oaks Storage facilities according to contract.

inclusions.description: Inclusions for the project, for example, items that are explicitly included in the terms of this project. Use 4000 or fewer characters.
inclusions.example: Includes drive through building and landscaping materials.

exclusions.description: Exclusions for the project, for example, items that are explicitly excluded in the terms of this project. Use 4000 or fewer characters.
exclusions.example: Excludes additional purchases of landscaping materials.

terms.description: Terms of the project, these may include additional terms or performance obligations. Use 4000 or fewer characters.
terms.example: Follow all safety rules and security procedure that are in force and applicable during execution of work.

scheduleDetails.description: References the schedule information for the project.

scheduledStartDate.description: Scheduled start date, the date the project is scheduled to start.

scheduledCompletionDate.description: Original scheduled completion date, the date the project is scheduled to be completed.

actualStartDate.description: Actual start date, the date the project actually started.

actualCompletionDate.description: Actual completion date, the date the project was actually completed.

revisedCompletionDate.description: Revised completion date, the revised date the project is scheduled to be completed.

substantialCompletionDate.description: Substantial completion date, the date the work for the project is considered substantially complete.

noticeToProceedDate.description: Notice to proceed date, the date when the project received formal notice to proceed.

responseDueDate.description: Response due date, the date when a response is expected from an external party for the project.

executedOnDate.description: Executed on date, the date the project was formally executed.

scheduleImpactNotes.description: Provide additional context about any impacts on the current schedule for the project. Use 100 or fewer characters.
scheduleImpactNotes.example: There are currently no schedule impacts.

taxSchedule.description: If Advanced Tax or VAT is enabled, the tax schedule used to capture tax details for the project.

key.description: Unique key for the tax schedule.

id.description: Unique ID of the tax schedule.

href.description: URL endpoint for the tax schedule.

taxSolution.description: Tax solution used to calculate and capture taxes on the project.

key.description: Unique key for the tax solution.

href.description: URL endpoint for the tax solution.

objects.projects.project-resource.description: Project resources represent people or employees assigned to a project. You can assign a resource, typically an employee, to a project, including details such as billing rates, roles and assignment dates.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the project resource.

id.description: Unique identifier for the project resource. This is the same as `key` for this object.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project resource.

startDate.description: Start date for the project resource, the date on which the project resource is scheduled to begin work.

employee.description: References the employee identified as the project resource.

key.description: Unique key for the employee.

startDate.description: Start date for the employee, the date on which the employee is scheduled to begin work.

endDate.description: End date for the employee, the date on which the employee is scheduled to end work.

href.description: URL endpoint for the employee.

employeeContact.description: References the contact information for the employee identified as the project resource.

key.description: Unique key for the employee contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the employee contact.

item.description:
References an item for setting project-specific pricing for the project resource. You can assign an item to a project resource to set project-specific pricing for the resource.  The following rules apply when assigning an item to a project resource: 

- If pricing is set for an item without specifying an employee, the pricing applies to the item regardless of the employee.
- If an employee and item are specified together with a `laborRate` or `expenseRate`, the pricing applies to timesheet entries or expenses entered by the employee.

  For more information, watch the video [assign project resources and pricing](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Video_assign_project_resources_pricing) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

key.description: Unique key for the item.

href.description: URL endpoint for the item.

pricing.description:
Specifies the method used to determine pricing for the project resource, either `laborPricingMethod` or `expensePricingMethod`.

For more information, watch the video [assign project resources and pricing](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Video_assign_project_resources_pricing) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

laborPricingMethod.description:
Specifies the method used to determine labor pricing for the project resource. Labor pricing is based on a predefined billing rate or cost plus a markup percentage.

- `billingRate` - Pricing is based on a predefined billing rate. 
- `costPlusFee` - Pricing is based on actual costs plus a markup percentage.

laborRate.description: Specifies the default labor rate for the project resource, applied when the resource logs time to the project. If a project resource has a specified `item` and the `laborRate` differs from the item's rate, the `laborRate` takes precedence. If they have multiple labor rates for the same scheduled time, only the first rate is applied.

expensePricingMethod.description:
Specifies the method used to determine expense pricing for the project resource.

- `billingRate` - Pricing is based on a predefined billing rate. 
- `costPlusFee` - Pricing is based on actual costs plus a markup percentage.

expenseRate.description: Specifies the default expense rate for the project resource, applied when the resource logs expenses to the project.

apPurchasingPricingMethod.description: Specifies the pricing method to be used for Accounts Payable (AP), and Purchase Order (PO) transactions, `costPlusFee` indicates that pricing is based on actual costs plus a markup percentage.

apPurchasingRate.description: Specifies the default percentage used to calculate pricing for the project resource, applied when generating invoices for Accounts Payable (AP) and Purchase Order (PO).

project.description: References the project associated with this project resource.

key.description: Unique key for the project.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project.

objects.projects.project-status.description: Project statuses let you track the progress of projects through different states, used to categorize and report on projects.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for project status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the project status.

description.description: Provides a brief description of the purpose of the project status.
description.example: Project is in the planning phase and not yet open for time or expense entry.

disableTimesheetEntry.description: Indicates whether to create timesheet entries for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent timesheet entries.

disableExpenseEntry.description: Indicates whether to create expense entries for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent expense entries.

disablePurchasingAPEntry.description: Indicates whether to create Accounts Payable (AP) or Purchase Order (PO) entries for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent AP/PO entries.

disableGenerateInvoice.description: Indicates whether to generate project invoices for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent invoice generation.

href.description: Endpoint for this project status.

objects.projects.project-type.description: Project types let you group projects into categories for reporting.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the project type.

id.description: Unique identifier for the project type.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project type.

parent.description: References the project type of the immediate parent project in the project hierarchy when the current project is a child project.

key.description: Unique key for the parent project type.

id.description: Identifier for the parent project type.

href.description: URL endpoint for the parent project type.

objects.projects.project-group.description: A project group is a specified set of projects, or a set of projects that meet certain criteria. Use groups to filter or display information in multiple ways, for example, by showing data from only certain projects.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the project group.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project group.

groupType.description:
Specifies the group membership type for the project. The group type and related fields determine how projects will be organized hierarchically and how related projects will be managed in the Projects list. There are two types of project groups:





  - `specific` - Specify the projects to include and their hierarchical relationships in the `groupMembers` array.
  - `all` - Include all projects that match the `memberFilter` criteria.

Depending on the group type, you can either specify individual projects to include and their order, or include all projects that match certain criteria. This will impact how parent and child projects are displayed and managed, providing up to 5 levels of hierarchical organization for enhanced billing flexibility and organizational clarity.

memberFilter.description:
One or more filters to select the projects to include in the project group, can be used with both `all` and `specific` group types. 

You can use this filter to show only projects managed by the current user: `{"$eq":{"manager.id":"current(user)"}}`

groupMembers.description: References member projects of the project group and their sort order. Applies only when `groupType` = `specific`.

key.description: Unique key for the project.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project.

isDimensionStructure.description: Indicates whether a dimension structure is created from the group. If `true`, the group can be added to the rows or columns of a financial report.

objects.projects.project-group-member.description: A project group member represents a project that is assigned to a project group.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the project group member.

id.description: Unique ID for the project group member. This value is the same as the `key` for this project group member.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project group member.

sortOrder.description: Sort order for the project group member.

key.description: Unique key for the project.

isMilestone.description: Set to `true` if tasks created from this standard task are milestones.

isUtilized.description: Set to `true if tasks created from this standard task are utilized. A utilized task indicates progress on a customer project or internal project.

priority.description: Priority of tasks created from the standard task.

timeType.description: Time type of the standard task.

objects.projects.task.description:
Tasks simplify the process of capturing task data for projects as you enter transactions. The uniqueness of a task is bound to a specific project, meaning you cannot select a task without first identifying the project. 

For more information, read more about [task dimensions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Task_dimension_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the task.

id.description: Unique identifier for the task (20 characters maximum).

description.example: Conduct detailed sessions with the client to identify. document, and validate business, functional, and technical requirements.

parent.description: Specifies the parent task to which this task is subordinate.

key.description: Unique key for the parent task.

href.description: URL endpoint for the parent task.

project.description: Specifies the project that the task is associated with.

key.description: Unique key for the project.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project.

customer.description: Specifies the customer associated with this task for billing purposes.

key.description: Unique key for the customer.

href.description: URL endpoint for the customer.

item.description: Specifies the work item associated with this task. Assigning an item is required for the task to be billable and included in customer invoicing.

key.description: Unique key for the item.

href.description: URL endpoint for the item.

planned.description: Defines the scheduled start and end dates for the task.

startDate.description: Specifies the date on which the project is scheduled to begin.

endDate.description: Specifies the date on which the project is scheduled to end.

actual.description: Defines the actual start and end dates for the task.

startDate.description: Specifies the date on which the project actually began.

endDate.description: Specifies the date on which the project actually ended.

duration.description: Indicates planned, estimated, actual, approved and remaining time values, including both total and billable durations.

planned.description: The initial scheduled duration of the task, measured in hours.

plannedBillable.description: The portion of the planned duration expected to be billable to the customer, measured in hours.

estimated.description: Represents the current estimated total duration of the task, measured in hours.

estimatedBillable.description: The current estimated total duration of the task, in hours, based on updated information or progress.

actual.description: The total number of hours recorded against the task. Reflects the actual effort spent to date, regardless of billable status.

actualBillable.description: The total number of billable hours recorded against the task. Represents the portion of actual work eligible for invoicing.

approved.description: The total number of hours recorded against the task that have been reviewed and approved, regardless of billable status.

approvedBillable.description: The total number of billable hours recorded against the task that have been reviewed and approved for invoicing.

remaining.description: The estimated number of hours required to completed the task, this is automatically calculated.

percentComplete.description: Indicates the calculated percentage of task completion, recorded as a decimal. For example, a value of `0.25` represents 25% completion. This value is automatically calculated by dividing the actual hours worked on the task by the estimated duration.

observedPercentComplete.description: Represents the manually entered percentage of task completion, recorded as a decimal. For example, a value of `0.75` represents 75% completion.

isMilestone.description: Indicates whether the task is a milestone. Set to `true` to designate the task as a key project checkpoint or deliverable.

isUtilized.description: Indicates whether the task contributes to project utilization. Set to `true` to mark the task as utilized, meaning the time spent is considered productive work on a customer or internal project. When set to `false`, represents a non-productive task, such as administration.

isBillable.description: Indicates whether the time recorded against the task is billable to a customer. Set to `true` to include the task in invoicing.

wbsCode.description: Specifies the work breakdown structure (WBS) code for the task. This code can contain up to 8 characters and is used to categorize and organize tasks within the project.

priority.description: Specifies the task's priority using a numeric value, A numeric value indicating the task priority.

taskStatus.description: Indicates the current status of the task. Once a task is marked as `completed`, no additional time entries can be recorded against it.

timeType.description:
Specifies the time type to be associated with this task, such as salary or overtime. Used for posting labor costs to the general ledger and for tracking how working time is categorized. 

This field is required if labor cost posting is enabled. For more information, read about how to [setup labor cost posting](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Set_up_labor_cost_posting) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

key.description: Unique key for the time type.

href.description: URL endpoint for the time type.

class.description: Specifies the class associated with the task.

key.description: Unique key for the class.

href.description: URL endpoint for the class.

attachment.description: Identifies a document associated with the task, such as a statement of work, technical specification, project plan or agreement.

key.description: Unique key for the attachment.

href.description: URL endpoint for the attachment.

dependentOn.description: Specifies the predecessor task that must be completed before this task can begin. Used to establish task dependencies and enforce proper sequencing within the project schedule.

key.description: Unique key for the predecessor task.

href.description: URL endpoint for the predecessor task.

productionUnits.description: Used to track measurable output resulting from various cost inputs, such as material, labor, and equipment.

estimate.description: Specifies the estimated number of production units expected to be completed for the task.

description.description: Defines the unit of measurement for tracking production output.

root.description: Identifies the top-level task in the hierarchy from whcih this task originates.

id.description: Identifier for the root task. If the task has a parent, this is the `id` of the topmost parent. If not, it is the `id` of the task itself.

key.description: Unique key for the root task. If the task has a parent, this is the `key` of the topmost parent. If not, it is the `key` of the task itself.

name.description: Name of the root task. If the task has a parent, this is the `name` of the topmost parent. If not, it is the `name` of the task itself.

href.description: URL endpoint for the root task.

standardTask.description:
Specifies a predefined standard task used as the template for this task, defining consistent settings such as name, duration and billing attributes.

For more information, read about the [Standard Task Catalog](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Standard_tasks_catalog) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

key.description: Unique key for the standard task.

href.description: URL endpoint for the standard task.

overridePurchasingTaxSchedule.description: Indicates whether the purchasing tax schedule has been overridden for the task.

objects.projects.task-group.description: Task groups categorize task dimension records, mainly for the purpose of structuring financial reporting.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the task group.

id.description: Unique identifier for the task group.

href.description: URL endpoint for the task group.

description.description: Provides additional descriptive context about the task group.

groupType.description:
Specifies the group membership for the task group, which determines how tasks are selected for inclusion in the group. All tasks that meet the `memberFilter` criteria are included in the group. 

When creating reports that use tasks in rows or columns, `groupType`, `memberFilter`, and `isDimensionStructure` determine which headings will appear in the report and the order in which they will be displayed.

memberFilter.description: Defines the criteria used to select tasks to include in the task group. When `groupType` is set to `all`, all tasks that meet the criteria defined in the `memberFilter` are included in the group.

isDimensionStructure.description: Indicates whether a dimension structure is created from the task group, which, if `true`, can be added to the rows or columns of a financial report.

objects.projects.invoice-run.description: An invoice run record is created every time you generate an invoice for a project.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the invoice run.

id.description: Unique identifier for the invoice run. This value is the same as `key` for this object.

href.description: URL endpoint for the invoice run.

expensePriceMarkup.description: Specifies the percentage markup applied to expenses when generating invoices for a project.

description.description: Provides additional descriptive context about the invoice run.

isOffline.description: Indicates whether the invoice run was executed offline.

state.description:
Indicates the current status of the invoice run.

* `success` - The invoice run completed successfully without errors.
* `failed` - The invoice run encountered errors and did not complete successfully.
* `inTransit` - The invoice run is currently in progress.
* `partialSuccess` - The invoice run completed with some errors.

errorData.description: Indicates details of any errors encountered during invoice run.

invoiceRunDateTime.description: Specifies the date and time of the invoice run.

priceList.description: References the price list used to override pricing for transactions billed in the invoice run.

key.description: Unique key for the price list.

href.description: URL endpoint for the price list.

invoiceTemplate.description: References the invoice template used for generating invoices in the invoice run.

key.description: Unique key for the invoice template.

href.description: URL endpoint for the invoice template.

createdBy.description: References the user who created the invoice run.

key.description: Unique key for the user.

href.description: URL endpoint for the user.

objects.projects.project-billing-templat.description: A billing template defines the rules that you want to use for invoicing a line item on a sales order, including whether the line item should be billed only when it's completed or at a specific percentage of completion.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the project billing template.

id.description: Unique identifier for the project billing template. This value is the same as `key` for this object.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project billing template.

name.description: Name of the project billing template.

description.description: Provides additional descriptive context for the project billing template.
description.example: Template for billing by estimated project hours.

billingMethod.description: Indicates the billing method used in the project billing template.

calculateOn.description: Indicates the type of billing calculation for the project billing template.

basedOn.description: Indicates the metric used to determine how the billing amount is calculated in the project billing template.

milestones.description: Represents a collection of milestones associated with the project billing template.

objects.projects.project-billing-templat.description: A project billing template milestone represents a specific billable event or checkpoint within a project billing template used for milestone billing.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the project billing template milestone.

id.description: Unique identifier for the project billing template milestone. This value is the same as the `key` for this object.

percentCompleted.description: Indicates the project completion percentage that triggers invoice generation for this milestone.

percentToInvoice.description: Specifies the percentage of the total project amount that will be invoiced when the milestone is reached.

description.description: Provides additional descriptive context for the milestone.

projectBillingTemplate.description: Reference to the project billing template associated with this milestone.

Logical operators to apply when there are multiple filter conditions. The conditions in the `filters` array are implicitly numbered starting at 1. Supports `and`, `or`, and grouping with parentheses.

Shortcuts:
+ `and` by itself means that all conditions must be true.
+ `or` by itself means that at least one condition must be true.
